text: Can write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, update dependencies, and write release notes automatically
quote: writing tests for untested code, fixing lint errors across a project, resolving merge conflicts, updating dependencies, and writing release notes

text: Given a plain-language description, plans the approach and writes code across multiple files, then verifies it works

text: Works directly with git: stages changes, writes commit messages, creates branches, and opens pull requests
quote: Claude Code works directly with git. It stages changes, writes commit messages, creates branches, and opens pull requests.

text: Can read design docs in Google Drive, update Jira tickets, pull data from Slack, or use custom tooling via MCP
quote: Claude Code can read your design docs in Google Drive, update tickets in Jira, pull data from Slack, or use your own custom tooling.

text: CLAUDE.md project file sets coding standards, architecture decisions, and review checklists read every session
quote: CLAUDE.md is a markdown file you add to your project root that Claude Code reads at the start of every session. Use it to set coding standards, architecture decisions, preferred libraries, and review checklists.

text: Can spawn multiple agents that work on different parts of a task simultaneously, coordinated by a lead agent

text: Can execute across tens to hundreds of parallel subagents on the hardest tasks, checking work before it reaches the user
quote: Dynamic workflows: Tackle the most challenging tasks by executing across 10s to 100s of parallel subagents, and checking its work before anything reaches you.

text: Composable via Unix philosophy: can pipe logs into it, run it in CI, or chain with other tools
quote: Claude Code is composable and follows the Unix philosophy. Pipe logs into it, run it in CI, or chain it with other tools

text: Can be run on a schedule to automate recurring work like PR reviews, CI failure analysis, or dependency audits
quote: Run Claude on a schedule to automate work that repeats: morning PR reviews, overnight CI failure analysis, weekly dependency audits, or syncing docs after PRs merge.

text: Remote Control lets you keep working from your phone or any browser after stepping away from your desk
quote: Step away from your desk and keep working from your phone or any browser with Remote Control

text: Can kick off a long-running task on web or mobile, then pull it into your terminal with `claude --teleport`

text: Can be routed tasks from team chat by mentioning @Claude in Slack with a bug report, returning a pull request

text: Can be tagged directly on GitHub as @claude to kick off work

text: Provides automatic code review on every pull request via GitHub Code Review integration

text: Desktop app supports visually reviewing diffs and running multiple sessions side by side
quote: Review diffs visually, run multiple sessions side by side, schedule recurring tasks, and kick off cloud sessions.

text: Can run long tasks in the cloud, work on repos not available locally, and run multiple tasks in parallel while you check back later
quote: Kick off long-running tasks and check back when they're done, work on repos you don't have locally, or run multiple tasks in parallel.

text: Maps and explains entire codebases in seconds using agentic search, without manual selection of context files
quote: Claude Code maps and explains entire codebases in a few seconds. It uses agentic search to understand project structure and dependencies without you having to manually select context files.

text: Integrates with GitHub, GitLab, and CLI tools to handle full workflow: reading issues, writing code, running tests, submitting PRs
quote: Claude Code integrates with GitHub, GitLab, and your command line tools to handle the entire workflow—reading issues, writing code, running tests, and submitting PRs—all from your terminal.

text: Can debug a live running web application through Chrome integration

quote: the Agent SDK lets you build your own agents powered by Claude Code's tools and capabilities, with full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions.

text: JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, etc.) provides interactive diff viewing and selection context sharing
quote: A plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and other JetBrains IDEs with interactive diff viewing and selection context sharing.

text: VS Code extension provides inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and conversation history in the editor
quote: The VS Code extension provides inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and conversation history directly in your editor.

text: Can be run directly from a project directory via the `claude` terminal command
quote: The full-featured CLI for working with Claude Code directly in your terminal. Edit files, run commands, and manage your entire project from the command line.

text: Can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
quote: Claude Code can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

text: Can implement a feature described in an issue tracker (e.g. JIRA) and create a corresponding GitHub pull request

text: An MCP server can push messages into a session so Claude reacts to Telegram, Discord, or webhook events while unattended

text: Supports creating custom skills to package repeatable team workflows like /review-pr or /deploy-staging

quote: Hooks let you run shell commands before or after Claude Code actions, like auto-formatting after every file edit or running lint before a commit.

text: In CI, can automate code review and issue triage via GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD
quote: In CI, you can automate code review and issue triage with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD.

text: Can log in using an existing Claude Pro or Max subscription instead of a separate API key
quote: Claude Pro or Max subscription: log in with your Claude.ai account.

text: Supports ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable for direct API authentication, bypassing the interactive login prompt

quote: Claude for Enterprise: adds SSO, domain capture, role-based permissions, compliance API, and managed policy settings for organization-wide Claude Code configurations.

text: Reviews code for security issues, drafts patches, and explains risk in accessible language

text: Sandboxed Bash tool enforces filesystem and network isolation, letting Claude run most shell commands without per-command approval
quote: Learn how Claude Code's sandboxed Bash tool provides filesystem and network isolation for safer, more autonomous agent execution. The Bash sandbox lets Claude run most shell commands without stopping to ask permission. Instead of approving

quote: Agent view: One place to manage all your Claude Code sessions.

text: Routines can be configured once and then run on a schedule, via API call, or in response to an event
quote: Routines: Configure a routine once, and it can run on a schedule, from an API call, or in response to an event.

text: Computer use lets Claude open apps, navigate the browser, and run dev tools to complete tasks
quote: Computer use: Claude now opens your apps, navigates your browser, and runs your dev tools to complete tasks.

text: Can query internal databases in plain language, e.g. finding user emails from a PostgreSQL database by feature usage
quote: Find emails of 10 random users who used feature ENG-4521, based on our PostgreSQL database.

quote: Stdio servers run as local processes on your machine. They're ideal for tools that need direct system access or custom scripts.

quote: You can also have Claude scaffold a server for you with the official mcp-server-dev plugin.
